# chadcn-ux

> Day-one CLI for chadcn. Requires Node.js 22+.

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/jasonkneen/chadcn/blob/main/packages/cli/AGENTS.md)
- [CLI README](https://github.com/jasonkneen/chadcn/blob/main/packages/cli/README.md)
- [Website and catalog](https://chadcn.dev)

Commands: init, add, view, search. Installation delegates to shadcn 4.21.0.
Bare names use its default registry; registry URLs and namespaces pass through.
Private workspace compositions are not yet distributed. WebMCP is not implemented.
